title: Brown compactness tested on thick generators
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a commutative condensed coefficient ring. Put S=Dctf(X,Λ), L=Loc(S) [sk-def-localizing-closure], and equip L with its canonical inherited triangulation. Let E be a family of objects of L, indexed in any universe, whose underlying objects lie in S. Suppose every object of L with underlying object in S belongs to the thick envelope of E together with all zero objects. Then BrownHypothesesFor Λ X [lem-sfb-brown-hypotheses-criterion] is equivalent to S being triangulated, isomorphism-closed, retract-closed and essentially small in the fixed universe, and to the existence of fixed-universe coproducts on L making every E_i compact [def-pc-compact-object]. The envelope is taken in L with its inherited shift. Compactness is a hypothesis in the reverse direction, not an arbitrary-field conclusion.

proof.text: Apply the forward objectwise Brown criterion to obtain thickness, essential smallness and fixed-universe coproducts. Each supplied E_i has constructible finite-Tor underlying object, so the criterion makes it compact.

Conversely install the supplied coproduct structure. By the proved theorem compactObjects_isThick, the compact objects of the actual localizing full subcategory form a triangulated retract-closed property R. It contains each E_i by assumption and all zero objects. The universal property ObjectProperty.triangEnvelope_le_iff therefore places the thick envelope of ofObj(E) union IsZero inside R. The covering hypothesis gives compactness for every object whose underlying complex lies in S. Apply the reverse objectwise Brown criterion with the same thickness, essential smallness and coproduct witnesses. This introduces no assertion of geometric compactness.

theorem brownHypothesesFor_iff_compact_thick_generators
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [(localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).IsTriangulated]
    {G : Type*} (E : G → (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
    (hE : ∀ i, constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X (E i).obj ∧
      DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ (E i).obj)
    (hcover : ∀ K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory,
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X K.obj ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K.obj) →
      (ObjectProperty.ofObj E ⊔ IsZero).triangEnvelope K) :
    BrownHypothesesFor Λ X ↔
      let S := constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X ⊓
        fun K ↦ DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K
      S.IsTriangulated ∧ S.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧ S.IsStableUnderRetracts ∧
        ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} S ∧
        ∃ hSums : HasCoproducts.{u + 1} (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory,
          letI := hSums
          ∀ i, IsCompactObject (E i)
